newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks close off lows after Wall St bounces.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks close off lows after Wall St bounces.

text.p: MADRID, Sept 3 (Reuter) 1505 GMT - Madrid stocks closed sharply lower on Tuesday but off lows in line with Wall Street and bonds after a nervous, occasionally volatile session.
World financial markets were hit by news of a U.S. missile attack on Iraq which coupled with fears that U.S. rates might rise more than originally anticipated, dragging bourses lower.
* General index down 2.44 points, 0.69 percent, to 352.01
* Ibex down down 29.56 points, 0.73 percent, to 4,004.00
* Telefonica managed to reverse losses, ending up 5 pesetas to 2,340 supported by strong first half results and an upgraded recommendation by Goldman, dealers said.
Firms which have performed well up to recently-reported results were the worst hit amid general selling, dealers said.
Two such were food distribution chain Pryca, which fell 115 pesetas to 2,955 and property group Metrovacesa which dropped 55 pesetas to 4,155.

Dealers said that aside from events abroad, the bourse should be supported by concrete details on the 1997 budget, due to be announced before the end of the month. Up to then prices may be volatile, and particularly sensitivity to foreign news.
